title: Reaction Alert (draft)
description: DRAFT. An alert emitted when a declared threshold condition is observed. Field names and value domains are under research and are not final. No thresholds are agreed in this repository; each alert therefore records the threshold that produced it.

alert_id.description: Stable identity for deduplication. Derived from reaction, event_type and triggering chain position.

event_type.description: What was observed. Descriptive only - no alert type may assert a future outcome.

threshold.description: The condition that produced this alert, recorded inline so a historical alert stays interpretable after thresholds change.

status.description: Every threshold in this repository is unresolved. Other values are reserved and not in use.

chain_reference.description: The onchain fact behind the alert, so a recipient can verify rather than trust.

supersedes.description: alert_id this alert corrects or retracts, if any. Required for reorg handling.

limitations.description: Known weaknesses of this observation, carried with the alert rather than documented elsewhere.
